findings.body: Actual values still receive identifiers derived only from a random result UUID; no matching transactions, full count/total, immutable source and mapping pins, permitted scope, or pagination state are prepared or retained. Thus clickable Actuals and available Actual subtotals cannot yet open the required transaction sets. Per the stage assignment, the later DRILL/PAGES task must implement these handles and paging semantics.
findings.title: Later: DRILL/PAGES must replace synthetic drilldown IDs with prepared handles

findings.body: The committed `QUERY.json` contains transient branch and review bookkeeping, is outside the permitted path set, and is not needed by the query implementation or its tests. It should be removed from the product change.
findings.title: Simpler: remove branch-local task state → keep only the permitted implementation paths
